basicDetails.schemeName: Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Overseas Scholarship Scheme

nodalDepartmentName.label: Department of Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md:
The "Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Overseas Scholarship Scheme" was launched by the Department of Welfare of Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Minorities and Backward Classes, Government of Jharkhand, provides financial assistance to deserving Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Minorities, and Backward Class students for pursuing postgraduate education in top-ranked universities abroad.
> **Objective*****:*** The scheme's objective is to empower meritorious students by enhancing access to quality education, offering opportunities for global exposure, and promoting social equity. The partnership with the Chevening Scholarship enhances the scope of this initiative. Financial support is provided for tuition fees, living expenses, travel, and other academic-related costs. Under this, every year a maximum of 10 (ten) students from Scheduled Tribes, maximum 05 (five) from Scheduled Castes, maximum 03 (three) from Minorities and maximum 07 (seven) from Backward Classes, a total of 25 (twenty five) students will be selected and financial assistance will be provided to pursue higher level education such as Masters / M.Phil Full Degree Program in selected courses in leading universities located abroad. Thus, out of total 25 (twenty five) students, 05 (five) students who will be selected under Chevening Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Scholarship Scheme, their entire tuition fees will be borne by the Jharkhand Government, which will be maximum of £ 94,000 GBP per year. The remaining costs above £ 94,000 GBP of the selected 05 (five) students will be borne by the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO). Remaining 20 (twenty) students who will not be selected under Chevening Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Scholarship Scheme will be provided financial assistance under Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Overseas Scholarship Scheme.'
> ***Priority for disciplines:*** - Engineering and Technology - Data Sciences and Machine Learning - Management Studies - Finance - Water Studies - Pharmacology and Pharmacy Studies - Energy Studies - Conflict Studies - Migration and Refugee Studies
schemeContent.benefits_md:
- Provides financial assistance to students to pursue higher studies abroad.
- Covers tuition fees for selected postgraduate programs up to £94,000/- per year.
- Monthly living allowance for students based on their location (London or other regions).
- Return airfare in the economy class for travel between India and the UK.
- Additional grants for thesis submission, exams, and related expenses.
- Encourages representation of women by reserving 30% of the seats for female applicants.

The interested applicants visit the official
Chevening website
to apply.
Step 1: Complete the online registration form

Once you’ve clicked on the application system, you will first be asked to read and consent to the Chevening terms and conditions and Privacy Notice, and register your email address and mobile phone number. You will then receive an email with a link to the application portal.
Step 2: Pass the eligibility checker
After you have clicked on the link to the application portal, answer the eligibility questions to confirm your eligibility for a Chevening Scholarship.
You will find out immediately if you passed or failed the eligibility checker. If you did not pass but think there was an error, you will be given two more attempts.
If you pass the eligibility checker, you will receive an email to your registered email address with a link to continue your application.
Tip: Take the eligibility quiz on our website to find out if you will pass the eligibility checker!
Step 3: Make a note of your access code
Once you have followed the link in your email to continue your application, you will see an access code displayed on your screen. This access code is unique to you.
You must make a note or take a photo of your unique access code for your records as you will need it every time you want to access your application.
Step 4: Complete each section of the application form
You will now be able to start your Chevening application.
When completing the form, keep in mind that you will be logged out of the system if you are inactive for 15 minutes, so remember to save your progress as you work through each stage!
You will need to complete each section of the application form:
Personal Details:
Provide your full name, pronouns, date of birth, address, and preferred interview location.
Immigration Details:
Confirm your country of citizenship, passport number (where available), and other relevant details.
Education History:
Enter details of your education, including names of institutions attended, courses studied, and results received. You can add up to 15 entries.
Work History:
You can add up to 15 entries of past work experiences to the application form.

The system will then calculate if you meet Chevening’s requirement for 2,800 hours of work experience by multiplying the number of weeks by the number of hours worked for each entry. You will be able to view your total number.
Find out more about the work experience requirement and the type of work that counts towards it.
Programmes of Study
Submit details of your top three UK master’s degree course choices. You can find a full list of Chevening eligible courses on the course finder.
You will be asked if you have already applied to each of your course choices. Please note that it is not a requirement to apply to your course choices before submitting your Chevening application.
Read more about preparing your UK university application.
Referees
On your application form will you be asked to submit the names, job details, and contact details of two referees.
If you are invited to interview, you will need to upload two letters written by your chosen referees to the online application system.
Find out more about references.
Essay Questions
Respond to the four Chevening essay questions on leadership, relationship-building, your course choices, and future career goals.
Each answer has a 500-word limit and must be in English.
We recommend you prepare your answers to the essay questions in a separate document, before copy and pasting them into the application form once finalised.
Read about how to score well on each of Chevening’s application criteria.
Equal Opportunities
Share your background information to help us monitor diversity and accessibility. This does not affect your application outcome.
Step 5:
Submit your application
Once you have ensured all sections of the application form are marked as ‘complete’:
Consent to the scholarship conditions outlined on the application form.
Click ‘submit application’ and ‘confirm submission’.
Give yourself a pat on the back!
Selection Process:
Eligible applications will be shortlisted by the Chevening Secretariat.
Selected candidates undergo an interview process with a panel, including representatives from the Jharkhand government and FCDO.
Final selection is based on merit and adherence to Chevening standards.

basicDetails.schemeName: Scheme of Post Matric Scholarship to Lower Income Group Student for Studies in India

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme "Post Matric Scholarship to Lower Income Group Students for Studies in India" by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Haryana aims to provide financial assistance to students from the Lower Income Groups to enable them to complete their Education. Eligible students pursuing recognized post-matriculation courses in India are provided with maintenance allowances, tuition fees, and additional benefits like study tour charges and thesis printing expenses. The scheme is implemented by the Government of Haryana through recognized educational institutions.
schemeContent.benefits_md:
**Maintenance Allowances** - ₹75/month for hostel residents and ₹60/month for day scholars pursuing degree courses in engineering, technology, medicine, architecture, and similar disciplines. - ₹65/month for hostel residents and ₹50/month for day scholars pursuing diploma/certificate courses in engineering, technology, or medicine. - ₹60/month for postgraduate courses in agriculture or community development (₹45 for day scholars). - ₹40/month for undergraduate courses like B.Sc., B.Com., or equivalent (₹27 for day scholars). **Tuition and Other Fees** - Coverage of mandatory fees, including tuition, library, games, medical, and examination fees, payable to the institution. **Study Tour Charges** - Up to ₹100 per year for professional courses, covering travel expenses (train, bus, etc.). **Thesis Printing Charges** - Coverage of expenses for typing or printing the thesis for postgraduate students.
> **Mode of Disbursement** > Direct transfer to the beneficiary’s bank account or payment through the institution. Students are advised to get the Aadhaar Seeding done in their Bank account before applying for the scholarship. > **Frequency of Disbursement** > Monthly maintenance allowances and reimbursement of other fees on a semester/annual basis. > **Validity** > Scholarships are valid only for the duration of the recognized course in a recognized institution.
schemeContent.exclusions_md:
1. The applicant pursuing studies through correspondence courses.
1. The applicant continuing professional studies in a different line after completing education in one professional line (e.g., pursuing LLB after B.Ed.).
1. The applicant holding any other scholarship/stipend of a higher value while availing of this scholarship.

basicDetails.schemeName: Banglar Awaas Yojana (BAY)

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: Banglar Awaas Yojana (BAY) is a housing scheme aimed at providing a pucca house (minimum 25 sq mt floor area) to houseless households and those residing in kutcha or dilapidated houses. Launched by the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), GOI in FY 2016-17, the scheme offers assistance of ₹130,000/- per house, distributed in three installments. The Central and State Government share the cost in a 60:40 ratio. Eligible beneficiaries also receive wages for unskilled labor and assistance for constructing toilets under &quot;Mission Nirmal Bangla Prakalpa&quot;. The assistance is credited directly to the bank account of the beneficiary.
schemeContent.benefits_md: - **Financial Assistance:** Beneficiaries receive ₹1,30,000/- per house, credited in three installments (1st installment: ₹60,000/-; 2nd installment: ₹60,000/-; 3rd installment: ₹10,000/-).  - **Wage Support:** Beneficiaries are entitled to 95 unskilled mandays of wages under the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS).  - **Assistance for Toilet Construction:** Eligible beneficiaries enlisted in the BLS 2012 receive additional support for constructing toilets under &quot;Mission Nirmal Bangla Prakalpa&quot;.

nodalDepartmentName.label: Women, Child Development & Social Security Department

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md:
The Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana was initiated by the Department of Women, Child Development, and Social Security, Government of Jharkhand. The objective of the Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana is to address negative perceptions about the birth of daughters in society, issues like female foeticide, child marriage, low female child sex ratio, and the weak educational status of girls. The scheme has been approved across the entire state of Jharkhand to address these issues. The objectives of this scheme are as follows:
Objectives of the Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana: > (a) Women's empowerment > (b) Emphasis on girls’ education > (c) Eradication of the child marriage practice > (d) Support for the educational expenses of girls in higher classes to reduce school dropout rates and encourage them towards higher education. > (e) Assistance for adolescent girls' health and personal hygiene. > (f) Enable adolescent girls to make independent decisions regarding their lives.

Document Preparation:
Ensure all required documents are ready, including Aadhaar, caste certificate, income certificate (if applicable), and Aadhaar-linked bank account details.

Login Setup:
Principals or headmasters (Institute Nodal Officers) register schools using their UDISE code on the

Student Registration:

Applications are verified by District Nodal Officers (DNOs) and forwarded to the District Level Approval Committee.

Payments are made through the Aadhaar Payment Bridge System (APBS) or PFMS/NACH for non-linked accounts.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The &quot;Atal Graha Jyoti Yojana&quot;, launched by the Energy Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide financial relief to domestic consumers with low energy consumption by subsidizing their electricity bills. The scheme benefits those whose monthly electricity consumption does not exceed 150 units. The subsidy is provided through the billing system, ensuring easy access for eligible consumers. The scheme was earlier known as &quot;Indira Graha Jyoti Yojana&quot;.

basicDetails.schemeName: Makhana Vikas Yojana

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md:
“Makhana Vikas Yojona” launched by the Department of Agriculture, Bihar, is designed to boost the cultivation and productivity of Makhana in 10 designated districts of Bihar. It focuses on offering training to farmers and providing grants for traditional equipment used in Makhana cultivation and processing.
The scheme is to be implemented in 10 districts of the state under Schedule 1, 2 and 3 of the approval order, namely, Katihar, Purnia, Darbhanga, Madhubani, Kishanganj, Supaul, Araria, Madhepura, Saharsa and Khagaria.
schemeContent.benefits_md: - **Training:** Workshops and training for farmers to adopt modern methods and improve productivity. - **Equipment Kits:** Grants of 75% of the cost (up to ₹16,575/-) for traditional tools (i.e. Auka, Ganj, Kara, Khainchi, Chalni, Chatai, Afra, and Thaapi used in Makhana cultivation).

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: "Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education. "Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education. The primary objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from poor families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies. The scholarships are awarded based on the results of the Higher Secondary/ Class 12th Board Examination. A maximum of 82,000 fresh scholarships per annum are provided for pursuing Graduate/ Postgraduate degrees in colleges and universities and for professional courses, such as Medical, Engineering etc.
Rate of Scholarship
₹12,000/-per annum at the Graduation level for the first three years of College and University courses.
₹20,000 per annum at the Post-graduation level.
₹20,000/-per annum in the 4th and 5th year to the Students pursuing professional courses, in case, where the duration of the course is five (5) years/Integrated course.
Students pursuing technical courses such as B.Tech, B.Engg. will get scholarship up to graduation level only i.e. ₹12,000 p.a. for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd year and ₹20,000 in the 4th year.
Mode of Disbursal
The scholarship will be disbursed directly into the Aadhar seeded bank accounts of the beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
Students who are pursuing correspondence or distance mode or pursuing Diploma courses are not eligible.
Students who are already availing the benefit from any other scholarship schemes including State-run scholarship schemes/ fee waiver & reimbursement schemes are not eligible.
One Time Registration (OTR)
Step 1:
Visit the National Scholarships Portal (NSP) One Time Registration page and Click on “Apply for OTR”
Step 2:
Guidelines for OTR will appear. Scroll to the bottom. Read carefully the undertaking. Accept the Terms. Click “Next”.
Step 3:
Register your active mobile number in the OTR registration form. All correspondence/communication will be done on the submitted mobile/e-mail only.
Step 4:
Complete Aadhaar e-KYC by entering Parent/Legal Guardian/Student Aadhaar number. Submit the OTP received and Click “verify”
Step 5:

Enter details on the next page and click “Finish”. You will receive a Reference Number. Download the NSP OTR App and the Aadhaar FaceRD App from Google Play Store and complete face authentication for generating OTR.
Step 6:
On successful face authentication, your 14-digit OTR number will be generated and sent via SMS.
Fresh Application
Step 1:
Visit the Applicant Login page of the National Scholarships Portal. Select “OTR Login” and enter your OTR number and password.
Step 2:
Type the Captcha and click “Login”.
Step 3:
On the next screen, provide the OTP received on your registered mobile number. You will be directed to the Password Reset screen. Create a new password and confirm.
Step 4:
Click “Submit”. You will be directed to the “Applicant’s Dashboard”.
Step 5:

On the left pane, click “Application Form”. The fields marked as * are compulsory. Fill in the details and upload the documents. The verification of credentials of the students (caste, educational qualifications etc.) will be done through the DIGILOCKER facility of the MeitY, Govt. of India.
Step 6:
You can either click on “Save as Draft” to complete the application later. Else, click “Final Submit” to apply.
Track Payment Status

The student can track their payment status from the template “Know Your Payment” in the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) Portal either by indicating their Aadhaar Number, Bank Account number or NSP Application ID.
NOTE 1:
The National Scholarships Portal will provide the timelines for opening & closing of the portal.
NOTE 2:

Online applications will be verified at two levels i.e. by the Institute, where the student is studying and thereafter by the concerned State Higher Education Department or any other Agency/ Official nominated by the State as State Nodal Agency (both for fresh and renewal applicants).
NOTE 3:

Students will not be permanently debarred for scholarships due to delay in renewal or verification. However, students will have to submit renewal applications within a cut-off date. Renewal for that year will not be allowed if an applicant misses this deadline. However, students can apply for renewal in the following year if they meet the eligibility conditions.﻿
Grievance Redressal

In case of any grievances/complaints regarding the above scheme, the same may be registered to the following link: http://pgportal.gov.in/grievancenew.aspx other than to the Nodal Officer whose email is available on the NSP portal (Services Tab).

basicDetails.schemeName: CM's Jibon Anuprerana Scheme

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme "CM's Jibon Anuprerana Scheme" by the Skill, Employment & Entrepreneurship Department, Government of Assam aims to provide one-time financial assistance to eligible full-time research scholars and full-time Divyang (differently-abled) research scholars from public institutions in Assam, thereby promoting academic excellence and innovation in Assam. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹25,000/- for research scholars and ₹40,000/- for Divyang research scholars as a one-time benefit during their scholastic journey. To be eligible, the applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam and must be admitted to PhD program in 2025 at Central or State Universities in Assam. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Employment and Craftsmen Training through the Directorate of Investment and Development of Skill Portal. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.

basicDetails.schemeName: Post-Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC/ST Candidates
basicDetails.implementingAgency: University Grants Commission, Government Of India

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md:
The scheme “Post Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC/ST Candidates” has been initiated to provide opportunities to the deprived sections of the society, viz. the Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) for undertaking postgraduate level studies in Professional subjects like Engineering &amp; Technology, Management, Pharmacy etc. in recognized Indian Universities/Institutions/Colleges. 
> **Objective:**

The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to 1000 SC/ST candidates to pursue postgraduate level studies in Professional courses.
schemeContent.benefits_md:
1. The tenure of the award is for two/three years depending upon the tenure of the postgraduate course and not for an extended period of study, if any.
1. Candidates selected for the award of PG scholarships (under ME/M.Tech.) shall be provided a Scholarship @ ₹7800/-per month for the duration of the PG Scholarship.
1. For other courses, the amount of scholarship will be paid @₹4500/- per month.
1. No contingency is payable to the students selected under the scheme with effect from the selection year 2017-18.
1. The scholarship shall be payable to the awardee from the date of joining the Post Graduate 1 year course during the selection year.
schemeContent.exclusions_md:
1. General category/ OBC candidates are not eligible to apply under the scheme.
   1. Candidates pursuing postgraduate courses in professional subjects through correspondence or in Distance Education mode are not eligible to receive financial assistance under this scheme.

National Scholarship Portal
after the issue of an advertisement to be published by the UGC once in a year through leading newspapers and Employment News and also on the UGC website.

Eligible candidates can apply by clicking on the “Apply Now” option.
Step 03:
Navigate to “Applicant Corner” and click on “New Registration”.
Step 04
: Fill all the mandatory details and click on the 'Register' button.
Step 05:
The mobile number will be verified and an OTP will be generated.
Step 06:
Now, login using OTP and fill out the application form.
Step 07:
After successful submission of the application form, an application ID and password will be generated which can be used for future references.
Step 08:
The host institution where the candidate is studying is required to verify the online application.
Procedure for release of the grant by the UGC:
Step 01:
After selection, the awardees will be paid a scholarship on DBT mode.
Step 02:
The list of awardees will be pushed to the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) by the NIC.
Step 03:

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. The students should belong to the SC/ST category.
   1. The candidate must have obtained a Graduate degree in the relevant subject and obtained admission at the Postgraduate level for regular full-time courses in any of the Professional subjects in a recognized University/Institution/College.
   1. Only students pursuing the first year of a postgraduate course during the current academic year are eligible to apply.
   1. For the purpose of award of the scholarship to students who are pursuing professional courses in the following Institutions/ Colleges/Universities:


  - Universities/Institutions/Colleges included under section 2(f) &amp; and 12(B) of UGC Act.
  - Deemed to be Universities included under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, and eligible to receive grants-in-aid from UGC.
  - Universities/Institutions/College funded by Central/State Government.
  - Institutes of National Importance.

**Note 01:** Courses which require approval from the Regulatory Council i.e. Medical Council of India (MCI), Dental Council of India (DCI), Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI), NCTIS, NCTE Bar Council of India (BCI), All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), INC, Forensic Regulatory &amp; Development Authority of India are considered professional courses.
**Note 02:** M.A., M.Sc., M.Com., MSW and Mass Communication and Journalism degree are accepted as “Non-professional courses”.
> **Renewals:**


   1. Scholarship granted under the scheme will be kept renewed during the period of first-year Post-Graduate courses subject to good conduct and maintenance of prescribed attendance.
   1. The scholarship will be renewed for the next year of study on receipt of an annual progress report to be granted by the administrative head of the University/ Institution/ College. (E.g. Registrar of a University/Director of the Institution/ Principal of the College or any other officer designated by them).
   1. Students failing to get promoted to the next class/level would forfeit the scholarship.
   1. Change in the course of study will not be permitted.
   1. The awardees of previous years will continue to follow the UGC pattern of assistance through the designated bank branches of Canara Bank.

> **Cancellation of Award:** The scholarship of a student may be cancelled in any of the following cases:-


   1. Failure of the awardee to pass the first year of the Post-Graduate course in first division or equivalent CGPA score.
   1. Discontinuation of studies due to personal reasons.
   1. The candidate is later found ineligible on account of false information provided in the online application or incorrect bank details.

basicDetails.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Sportspersons to Pursue Sports Coaching Courses Conducted by SAI, NSNIS, Patiala as a Part of Skill Development Programme to Improve their Employability
basicDetails.implementingAgency: Department Of Sports & Youth Services Department, Government Of Odisha

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The Scheme “Financial Assistance to Sportspersons to Pursue Sports Coaching Courses Conducted by SAI, NSNIS, Patiala as a Part of Skill Development Programme to Improve their Employability” was launched by the Department of Sports &amp; Youth Services Department, Government of Odisha to provide financial assistance to sportspersons of Odisha to help them become qualified coaches, by undertaking SAI, NSNIS coaching courses, so as to improve their employability.
schemeContent.benefits_md:
Sportspersons who apply and get selected to undergo SAl, NSNIS conducted coaching courses will be provided financial assistance as follows:-

   1. **Sportspersons under the BPL category:** 100% Course Fee plus an amount of ₹10,000/- for Diploma and long-term courses and ₹5,000/- for Six Weeks Certificate Courses to meet traveling and other miscellaneous expenses.   1. **Sportspersons of Non-BPL category:** 75% of the Course Fee plus an amount ₹5,000/- for Diploma and long-term courses and ₹2,500/- for Six Weeks Certificate Courses to meet traveling and other miscellaneous expenses.
schemeContent.briefDescription: The Scheme was launched by the Department of Sports & Youth Services Department, Government of Odisha to provide financial assistance to sportspersons of Odisha to help them become qualified coaches, by undertaking SAI, NSNIS coaching courses, so as to improve their employability.

children.text: The Scheme “Financial Assistance to Sportspersons to Pursue Sports Coaching Courses Conducted by SAI, NSNIS, Patiala as a Part of Skill Development Programme to Improve their Employability” was launched by the Department of Sports & Youth Services Department, Government of Odisha to provide financial assistance to sportspersons of Odisha to help them become qualified coaches, by undertaking SAI, NSNIS coaching courses, so as to improve their employability.
Sportspersons who apply and get selected to undergo SAl, NSNIS conducted coaching courses will be provided financial assistance as follows:-
Sportspersons under the BPL category:
100% Course Fee plus an amount of ₹10,000/- for Diploma and long-term courses and ₹5,000/- for Six Weeks Certificate Courses to meet traveling and other miscellaneous expenses.
Sportspersons of Non-BPL category:
75% of the Course Fee plus an amount ₹5,000/- for Diploma and long-term courses and ₹2,500/- for Six Weeks Certificate Courses to meet traveling and other miscellaneous expenses.
Application Process:
Step 01:
SAI, NSNIS, Patiala brings out an advertisement in the month of Jan/Feb every year about its forthcoming Courses and also uploads the details on its website:
https://nsnis.org/
Step 02:
Interested sportspersons who are eligible to undergo these Courses can apply to SAI, NSNIS, Patiala on their own by paying the required application fee.
NSNIS Registration Process:
Step 01:
Interested sportspersons can create a new account to register by providing the necessary details such as name, mobile number, email ID, and generate a password.
Step 02:
Complete the registration process and fill out the application form with personal and educational details.
Step 03:
Upload the required documents, including a passport-size photograph, attested BPL card, Aadhaar card, education certificate, achievement certificate, and a medical fitness certificate.
Step 04:
Pay the application fee and take a printout of the application form.
Step 05:
If selected for SAI, NSNIS coaching courses, submit the application form with the selection letter to the commissioner-cum-secretary, sports and Youth Services Department, Government of Odisha.
Note:

Sports & Youth Service Department finding the application genuine and eligible, shall sanction the financial assistance and remit the Course Fee directly to the SAI Bank account and the other amount to the bank Account of the applicant.
Modality of implementation of the Scheme:

Names of the applicants who are found eligible to undergo these Courses are uploaded on the SAI, NSNIS website, and individual letters are also sent to the selected applicants by SAI asking them to deposit the required Course Fee.

The selected applicant, if desirous of availing financial assistance from the State Government, is required to submit an application to the Sports & YS Dept. for financial assistance under the scheme. The application should be addressed to Commissioner-cum-Secretary, Sports & YS Dept. Govt. of Odisha accompanied with the letter of selection received from SAI, NSNIS, Patiala, or in case the letter is not received in time, print out of the website page displaying his/her selection along with a copy of his/her original application form submitted to SAI, NSNIS, Patiala. The applicant, if belongs to the BPL Category, must also submit a duly attested copy of the BPL Card along with the application failing which he/she will be treated as a non-BPL applicant.

In the case of a BPL Category applicant, the concerned District Sports Officer shall be asked to inquire into the BPL status of the applicant and get a certificate to that effect from the respective Block Development Officer and forward the same to the Dept.

Sports & YS Department, on finding the application genuine and eligible, shall sanction the financial assistance and remit the Course Fee directly to the SAI Bank Account and the other amount to the bank Account of the applicant.

In case of a large number of eligible applicants submitting applications for financial assistance, BPL applicants will get priority over non-BPL applicants. Amongst the BPL and non-BPL categories, an applicant shall be given priority if his/her career sporting achievements are better than others.

The beneficiary candidates who avail financial assistance from the govt. in prosecuting NSNIS course are to render two years’ service in the Sports & Youth Services Deptt. for coaching if the Deptt. will requisition their service with the benefits as per the rule in vogue given to the coaches at that time.
Disclaimer:

The scheme is intended only to enhance the employability of sportspersons of Odisha willing to take up sports coaching as a career option. This is just a skill development initiative. Sports & Youth Services Department, Odisha shall not be under any obligation to employ/engage/recruit the beneficiaries under its establishment after completion of their Courses. The beneficiaries are expected to search for jobs/engagements elsewhere on their own. If at any point in time the Sports and Youth Services Department issues advertisements for employment/engagement/recruitment of qualified Coaches under its own establishment, the eligible beneficiaries may apply for such opportunities. However, for such a selection process, the beneficiaries of the scheme not be given any preference whatsoever over other eligible applicants not availing any benefit under this scheme.

basicDetails.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Medical (JKBOCWWB)

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme "Financial Assistance for Medical" is a scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir. The scheme provides financial aid to registered workers' children for various medical needs, provided the worker has been engaged in building or construction work for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months. Under this scheme, workers can receive ₹5,000/- for injury treatment, ₹10,000/- for temporary disability, ₹75,000/- for permanent disability, and up to ₹1,00,000/- for the treatment of chronic diseases.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md:
The “Mobility Scheme” was launched under Knowledge Involvement in Research Advancement through Nurturing (KIRAN) Programme by the Department of Science &amp; Technology, Government of India, aims to address relocation issue of women scientists working in regular position in Government Organizations. The scheme aims to provide an opportunity to women scientists who are facing difficulties in their present job due to relocation (marriage, transfer of husband to any other location within the country, attending ailing parents, and accompanying children studying in different city) and will act as filler while searching other career option at new place.
The initiative intends to provide a harmonious environment during early phases of women scientists where they would like to stay active in research in addition to attending and fulfilling other responsibilities in the domestic front. It offers a contractual research award to women scientists and enables them for independent research.
schemeContent.benefits_md: - **Monthly Salary:** Consolidated monthly salary is provided to awardees for the entire project duration. - **Manpower Support:** Need-based manpower support is provided to assist in project implementation. - **Research Grant:** ₹5,00,000/- per annum is provided for consumables, contingencies, travel, and minor equipment. - ***Duration:*** Total tenure will be a maximum of five (5) years for this award. This award will not be available for renewal after completion of 5 years duration.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The "Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports- Fellowship Programme" by the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India. The scheme aims to sporting excellence by modernizing and augmenting the overall sports eco-system, developing a large pool of specialists in sports science, sports medicine, sports technology, sports nutrition, sports physiotherapy, and high-performance coaching, refereeing, and psychology. Under this scheme, fellowships for specialised studies, financial support for participation in and holding of seminars, workshops, clinics, and conferences, assistance for appearing in qualifying examinations and specialised training, research grants, and publication assistance are provided to officials of the Ministry, the Sports Authority of India, National Sports Federations, athletes, coaches, technical officials, students, and researchers. > **Scheme Implementation:** The scheme is implemented by the Department of Sports in association with its Autonomous Bodies, namely the Sports Authority of India, the Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education, the National Dope Testing Laboratory, the National Anti Doping Agency, and the National Sports University. > **Components of the Scheme:** The scheme will have the following components: (i) Fellowship Programme (ii) Exchange of Knowledge/ Research/ Ideas a) For attending seminars/ workshops/conferences of repute in India or abroad b) For holding training programmes/ seminars/ workshops/ clinics and conferences within the country (iii) Assistance to Match Officials, Coaches and Supporting Personnel (iv) Assistance for Research (v) Publication of Outstanding Works on sports related Subjects
schemeContent.benefits_md: - Fellowship for advanced and specialised training of short-term (up to 3 to 6 months) and long-term (up to 2 years) modules, workshops, courses, and programmes in India as well as abroad, in sports science disciplines such as Biomechanics, Sports Nutrition, Kinesiology, Anthropometry, Exercise Physiology, Sports Psychology, General Theory and Method of Training, Sports Medicine, Anti-doping, Sports Informatics, Sports Statistics and Sports Modelling, Sports Genetics, Sociology of Sports, Sports Management, and Sports Law. - Employees of the Central Government, State Governments, and Autonomous Bodies of the Department of Sports are assisted as per the Department of Personnel and Training (DoP&T) rates. - Nominations from State and Union Territory Governments may be invited for up to 40 percent of slots. - Up to 4 employees can be granted fellowship in a calendar year for the long-term programme of up to 2 years.
schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to develop specialists, coaches, officials, and researchers in sports. Under this scheme, fellowships, training support, research grants, and publication assistance are provided to sports personnel and institutions.

Employees of the Central Government, State Governments, and Autonomous Bodies of the Department of Sports are assisted as per the Department of Personnel and Training (DoP&T) rates.

The scheme aims to provide assistance to match officials, coaches, and other support personnel for appearing in qualifying examinations and for attending training and courses. > **Scheme Implementation:** The scheme is implemented by the Department of Sports in association with its autonomous bodies, namely the Sports Authority of India, the Lakshmibai National Institute of Physical Education, the National Dope Testing Laboratory, the National Anti-Doping Agency, and the National Sports University. > **Components of the Scheme:** The scheme will have the following components: (i) Fellowship Programme (ii) Exchange of Knowledge/ Research/ Ideas a) For attending seminars/ workshops/conferences of repute in India or abroad b) For holding training programmes/ seminars/ workshops/ clinics and conferences within the country (iii) Assistance to Match Officials, Coaches and Supporting Personnel (iv) Assistance for Research (v) Publication of Outstanding Works on sports related Subjects

basicDetails.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for OBC Students-Delhi

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to school-going students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC) families with an annual income not exceeding ₹2,50,000/- to support their pre-matric education.
schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The "Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for OBC Students-Delhi" is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented by the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Department, Government of NCT of Delhi, under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, to support the education of students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC) through scholarship assistance and ad-hoc grants. The scheme covers day scholars studying from Class I to Class X and hostellers studying from Class III to Class X. Scholarships are awarded to eligible students whose parents' or guardians' annual income from all sources does not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. The scholarship is tenable only in recognized institutions and is payable for 10 months in an academic year. Eligible students also receive an annual ad-hoc grant.
schemeContent.benefits_md: - **Scholarship for Hostellers:** ₹500/- per month for 10 months for students studying from Class III to Class X. - **Scholarship for Day Scholars:** ₹100/- per month for 10 months for students studying from Class I to Class X. - **Ad-Hoc Grant:** ₹500/- per student per annum for both hostellers and day scholars. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** - Scholarship is provided for 10 months during each academic year. - Ad-hoc grant is provided once per year.

basicDetails.schemeName: To Opt Composition Scheme

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enable eligible GST taxpayers to opt for the Composition Scheme for simplified tax compliance and payment under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime.
schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The "To Opt Composition Scheme" is a centrally sponsored scheme implemented by the Finance Department, Government of NCT of Delhi, which aims to enable eligible GST taxpayers to opt for the Composition Scheme through a simplified tax payment and compliance mechanism under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) system. Eligible new and existing taxpayers can apply online through the GST Portal by submitting the prescribed application form. Existing taxpayers must submit the application before the commencement of the relevant financial year. Applicants are also required to file Stock Intimation within 30 days from the date of opting for the Composition Levy. Composition taxpayers are required to file the prescribed quarterly statement and annual return under GST.
schemeContent.benefits_md: - **Simplified GST Compliance:** Eligible taxpayers can opt to pay tax under the Composition Scheme instead of the regular GST scheme, enabling a simpler tax payment and compliance process.

Eligible new and existing taxpayers can apply online through the GST Portal by submitting the prescribed application form. Existing taxpayers must submit the application before the commencement of the relevant financial year. Applicants are also required to file Stock Intimation within 30 days from the date of opting for the Composition Levy. Composition taxpayers are required to file the prescribed quarterly statement and annual return under GST.
Simplified GST Compliance:
Eligible taxpayers can opt to pay tax under the Composition Scheme instead of the regular GST scheme, enabling a simpler tax payment and compliance process.
Step 1:
To opt for composition levy, access the URL
https://www.gst.gov.in/.
The GST Home page will be displayed.
Step 2:
In case of New Registration, click on "Register" and proceed.
Step 3:
Log into the GST Portal by entering your login Credentials.
Step 4:
Once you have logged in, select ‘Application to Opt for Composition Levy’ from the Registration Menu.
Step 5:
You will be directed to a new screen – Application to Opt for Composition Levy. Your GSTIN, Legal Name of Business, Trade Name (if any), and Address of Principal Place of Business will be displayed.
Step 6:
Below that, your Nature of business and Jurisdiction will be listed.
Step 7:
Below these details, there is a Composition Declaration that you must check to pledge to abide by the conditions and restrictions for Taxpayers who are under the Composition Levy.
Step 8:

Before submission, you must also check the box for Verification (below the Composition Declaration) that states that all the information given is true and that nothing has been concealed from the authority.
Step 9:
Finally, before submission, select the Authorized Signatory from the drop-down menu and enter the Place.
Step 10:

Once you select the Authorized Signatory and enter the Place, the options to submit the form will get activated. Select the desired mode – DSC, E-sign, or EVC – and click the corresponding submission option. For the purpose of this manual, we will submit the application using DSC.
Step 11:
You will get a prompt to confirm your action, click on PROCEED to move forward.
Step 12:
The system will retrieve the installed digital signatures available on your system using the emSigner and you will get a pop-up to select the desired DSC. Select the desired signature.
Step 13:
Once you select the desired digital signature (it will get highlighted in blue), click Sign. If your digital signature is authenticated, you will get a SUCCESS message.
Step 14:
The system will perform some validations and if they are successful your ARN for the work item will be generated and sent to you via e-mail and SMS within the next 15 minutes.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: - The applicant must be a regular GST taxpayer. - The applicant must have an aggregate annual domestic PAN-based turnover within the limit specified from time to time under GST. - **New Taxpayers:** Any person who becomes liable to register under GST Act, after the appointed day, needs to file his option to pay composition amount in the Application for New Registration in Form GST REG-01. - **Existing Taxpayers:** Any taxpayer who is registered as normal tax payer under GST needs to file an application to opt for Composition Levy in Form GST-CMP-02 at GST Portal prior to the commencement of financial year for which the option to pay tax under the aforesaid section is exercised.

basicDetails.schemeName: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Polisher for Small Cardamom, Large Cardamom, Turmeric, etc (nos)

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage spice growers to adopt proper polishing methods for spices such as small cardamom, large cardamom, and turmeric to improve their appearance, quality, and marketability.
schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement – Polisher for Small Cardamom, Large Cardamom, Turmeric, etc. (Nos.) is implemented by the Spices Board, India, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. The scheme aims to encourage spice growers to adopt proper polishing methods for spices such as small cardamom, large cardamom, and turmeric to improve their appearance, quality, and marketability. By promoting the use of modern polishing equipment, the scheme helps produce high-quality spices that meet export standards and enhances the competitiveness of Indian spices in international markets. The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
schemeContent.benefits_md: 1. 50 % of cost of unit, subject to a maximum of ₹ 94,000/- per unit for General Category and 75% subject to maximum of ₹ 1,40,000 per unit for NE/SC/ST & 90% Spice Producer's Groups in Identified Clusters subjected to maximum of ₹ 1,70,000/- 1. Individual farmers having minimum of 0.40 ha - 8 ha of spices. 1. Assistance for groups/FPOs will be as in QGBG

basicDetails.schemeName: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) 2022- for Thrust Sectors: Scheme For Vaccine Manufacturing Units

state.label: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme “ Scheme For Vaccine Manufacturing Units” is a sub scheme under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)- 2022” for Thrust Sectors. It was launched on 07th May 2022 for a period of five years by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu. > **Objective of the "Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)- 2022”:** - The scheme envisages to provide incentives and assistance to the MSME Sector in order to nurture them and protect them from market vagaries thereby making them vibrant and successful. - The Scheme intends to provide impetus for the identified Thrust sectors such as Furniture, Marble, IT & ITeS , Electric Vehicles & Spare Parts, Toys and Semi-Conductor Industries Sector, Medical Equipment and Accessories, Medical diagnostics and AYUSH Products, Vaccine Manufacturing units, Food Processing, Marine Products thereby making the U.T as a hub of manufacturing of these Products. - To double the value of Export of the Processed Products as well as to make the U.T, a center for these identified export products. - To incentivize industry to take up environment protection measures for judicious use of scarce resources and as well as to ensure inter generational equity. - To reduce unemployment among the local residents and incentivize the industries to employ resident laborers. - To maximize Women participation in the business sector by providing incentives. - To encourage first generation Entrepreneurs and support them in their entrepreneurial endeavor. - To hone the Entrepreneurship skills of the youth of the Territory and create a skillful workforce. - To provide further fillip to the specialized Textile sector such as Technical textiles, Fabrics, Carpets, Garments, Apparels and Industries Manufacturing Textile Machinery, Medical Fabrics, therefore making the U.T. a Special Hub for Technical Textiles. - To promote innovation in Industrial sector by encouraging industry to involve themselves in Research & Development (R&D) works and to obtain Patents both, National and International Level. **Objective of the " Scheme For Vaccine Manufacturing Units" Sub-scheme:** Under this scheme, Credit-Linked Interest Subsidy and Capital Subsidy shall be provided to Vaccine Manufacturing Units.
schemeContent.benefits_md: Credit Linked Interest Subsidy for Vaccine Manufacturing Units @ 70% of interest charged by Bank with upper ceiling up to Rs.60 Lakhs per annum for 5 years OR for the period of repayment of loan whichever is earlier and Capital investment Subsidy @ 15% of the investment upto a maximum of 10 crores.
schemeContent.exclusions_md: - The Enterprise will not be eligible for Interest Subsidy under this Scheme if, term loan is sanctioned after one year from the date of commencement of commercial production.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: 1. The Scheme is applicable to New Enterprises and Existing Enterprises who had started commercial production during the operative period of the Scheme. 1. Only Gross Fixed Capital Investment (GFCI) made in New Building, New Plant & Machinery / Equipment and Machineries excluding land will be eligible for incentives for manufacturing. 1. Enterprise shall have to furnish information regarding production, sales, turnover, and employment etc. annually to concerned DIC before end of September each year. 1. Enterprise will have to observe pollution Control measures as prescribed by PCC or other competent authority. 1. Enterprise will have to remain in production for 5 years from the date of commercial production and if it fails to continue production for 5 years, the amount of Capital Investment Subsidy disbursed will be recovered as arrears of land revenue. 1. Out of Diversification and Expansion, only one activity once will be eligible for subsidy during the policy period. 1. Existing or New Enterprise carrying out an activity of Expansion or Diversification with an investment more than 50% (out of which minimum 60% investment should be in Plant & machinery) of GFCI will be eligible. 1. The Enterprise shall furnish Chartered Accountant certified bills. 1. Loan Sanctioned by Bank or Financial Institution as per RBI guidelines for the industry located in U.T. will be eligible for subsidy under this Scheme. 1. The Enterprise will not be eligible for Interest Subsidy under this Scheme if, term loan is sanctioned after one year from the date of commencement of commercial production. 1. Enterprise shall have to apply at online portal within one year from the date of first disbursement of loan or on or before the date of commencement of commercial production, whichever is later. 1. Interest subsidy will be eligible either from the date of first disbursement of loan or from the date of commencement of commercial production whichever is later. 1. Reimbursement of interest subsidy will be made only after commencement of commercial production of the enterprise. 1. If the Enterprise becomes defaulter in payment of interest or instalment of term loan to Bank/Financial institution as per guidelines of RBI and as mentioned in certificate of Bank/Financial institution such default period will be deducted. 1. The interest subsidy will be available only on interest levied by the financial institution/banks. 1. Interest Subsidy will not be available for penal interest or any other bank charges. 1. The eligible Enterprise shall have to bear a minimum of 2% interest levied on term loan by any Bank / Financial institution. The Enterprise shall submit details and undertaking in this regard. 1. The interest subsidy will be directly credited to Bank / Financial institution.

Enterprise will have to remain in production for 5 years from the date of commercial production and if it fails to continue production for 5 years, the amount of Capital Investment Subsidy disbursed will be recovered as arrears of land revenue.
Out of Diversification and Expansion, only one activity once will be eligible for subsidy during the policy period.

Existing or New Enterprise carrying out an activity of Expansion or Diversification with an investment more than 50% (out of which minimum 60% investment should be in Plant & machinery) of GFCI will be eligible.
The Enterprise shall furnish Chartered Accountant certified bills.

The Enterprise will not be eligible for Interest Subsidy under this Scheme if, term loan is sanctioned after one year from the date of commencement of commercial production.
Enterprise shall have to apply at online portal within one year from the date of first disbursement of loan or on or before the date of commencement of commercial production, whichever is later.

Reimbursement of interest subsidy will be made only after commencement of commercial production of the enterprise.

basicDetails.schemeName: Manohar Parrikar Goa Scholars Scheme

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The "Manohar Parrikar Goa Scholars Scheme, 2025" has been launched by the Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to promote postgraduate and Doctor of Philosophy studies among talented students from Goa, encourage admission to reputed institutions in India and abroad, and strengthen quality education, research, development, and innovation. It provides financial assistance for studies in India and abroad to meritorious scholars pursuing postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy programmes. **Objectives of the Scheme** To promote postgraduate and Doctor of Philosophy studies among talented youth of Goa. To recognize and support meritorious and outstanding candidates. To encourage admission in reputed institutions in India and abroad. To motivate students to undertake cutting-edge research. To promote quality education, research, development, and innovation. To contribute towards sustainable development through human capital creation.
schemeContent.benefits_md: **Scholarship for Studies in India:** - Financial assistance of ₹6,00,000 is provided to each selected scholar pursuing postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy studies in India. **Scholarship for Studies Abroad:** - Financial assistance of ₹15,00,000 is provided to each selected scholar pursuing postgraduate or Doctor of Philosophy studies abroad. **Number of Awards:** - Up to 40 scholars are selected every year. - In exceptional circumstances, the number of awards may be increased. - The total number of awards shall not exceed 50 in a year. **Mode of Disbursement:** - Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary's bank account.

basicDetails.schemeName: Scheme for Dronacharya Award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports and Games

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: "Scheme for Dronacharya Award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports and Games" has been launched by the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports. The award is conferred upon coaches who have made exceptional contributions to sports coaching and athlete development. **Objectives:** - To honour coaches who have consistently produced outstanding international-level sportspersons. - To motivate coaches to dedicate themselves to improving sports performance standards and bringing glory to India through international achievements. **Sports Disciplines Covered:** The award is given to coaches associated with: - Olympic sports disciplines. - Non-Olympic sports disciplines recognized by the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports. - Indigenous sports recognized by the Government of India. **Award Categories:** - Dronacharya Award (Regular) - Dronacharya Award (Lifetime Contribution) **Number of Awards:** - Ordinarily, not more than 5 awards are given in a calendar year. - Out of these, 2 awards are reserved for Lifetime Contribution in Coaching.
schemeContent.benefits_md: > **Selected awardees receive:** **Dronacharya Award (Regular)** - Statuette - Certificate - Ceremonial Dress - Cash Prize of ₹10,00,000 **Dronacharya Award (Lifetime Contribution)** - Statuette - Certificate - Ceremonial Dress - Cash Prize of ₹15,00,000 **Additional Information** - The awards are ordinarily conferred by the President of India on 29th August (National Sports Day). - No individual can receive the award more than once. - The award may be conferred posthumously.
schemeContent.exclusions_md: 1. The applicant is a recipient of the Arjuna Award (Lifetime) (earlier known as Dhyan Chand Award). 1. The applicant is involved in canvassing for the award. 1. A coach associated with doping violations becomes eligible only after completion of the prescribed punishment, suspension, or ban period. Achievements during the suspension period will not be considered. If an inquiry is pending, the concerned sportsperson's achievements will not be considered.
schemeContent.briefDescription: The award for Outstanding Coaches in Sports & Games is a prestigious national sports award instituted by the Government of India to recognize coaches who have consistently demonstrated outstanding & meritorious work in training sportspersons to achieve excellence at international competitions.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme "Top Class Education for Scheduled Caste Students" by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India aims to recognize and promote quality education among Scheduled Caste students by providing financial support for pursuing studies beyond Class 12. Through this scheme, scholarship assistance covering tuition fees, non-refundable charges, and academic allowance is provided to eligible Scheduled Caste students studying in notified institutions of excellence across the country. The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment through the National Scholarship Portal. A total of 1,900 fresh scholarships are awarded annually on the basis of merit. Thirty percent of the scholarship slots are reserved for eligible Scheduled Caste girl students. The scholarship is available for the full duration of the approved course, subject to satisfactory academic progress and fulfillment of the scheme conditions. The scheme seeks to reduce financial barriers and enable students from Scheduled Caste communities to access high-quality higher education opportunities.
schemeContent.benefits_md: 1. Full tuition fee and non-refundable charges shall be paid. 1. For private sector institutions, the fee support is subject to a ceiling of ₹2,00,000 per annum per student. 1. Academic Allowance: - ₹86,000 in the first year. - ₹41,000 in each subsequent year. 1. Allowance covers living expenses, books and stationery, computer/laptop, UPS, printer, and any other academic requirements necessary for successful completion of the course.
schemeContent.exclusions_md: 1. The applicant shall not be eligible if the annual family income exceeds ₹8,00,000. 1. The applicant shall not be eligible for a fresh scholarship if he/she is already studying in the 2nd year or a higher year of the course. 1. The applicant shall not be eligible if he/she is not studying in a notified institution covered under the scheme. 1. The applicant shall not receive benefits under any other similar scholarship scheme of the Central Government or a State Government for the same course of study. 1. More than 2 siblings from the same family shall not be eligible to receive benefits under the scheme. 1. The scholarship shall be discontinued if the applicant changes the institution after selection under the scheme. 1. The scholarship shall be stopped if the applicant fails to get promoted to the next academic year and shall be restored only after promotion to the next class/year.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme "Post Matric Scholarship Students With Disabilities" has been launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment for students with disabilities pursuing a post-matric qualification from UGC/AICTE recognized universities, i.e. students of Class 11th, Class 12th, including Polytechnics, Post-Matriculation Diploma/Certificates and Bachelor’s Degree/Diploma in India and Master’s Degree/Diploma. The students with the specified disabilities defined in Schedule of the "Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016" will be eligible under this scheme. This includes persons with visual, hearing, speech, loco-motor, mental retardation, and other disabilities. NOS is implemented offline by the DEPwD. At times SwDs are deprived of harnessing their latent skills and thereby miss the opportunity. This scheme aims to support SwDs to study further in order to prepare themselves to earn their livelihood and to find a dignified place for themselves in the society as they face several barriers physical, financial, psychological, mental in pursuing studies and living with dignity.
schemeContent.benefits_md: > **Maintenance Allowance (₹ per Month):** 1. **Group 1:** All Bachelor’s/Post-Graduate Degree Courses in Medicine, Engineering/Technology, Planning/Architecture, Fashion Technology, Management, Business/Finance Administration, Computer Science/Applications, Agriculture, Veterinary and Allied Sciences; **Hostellers – 1600/-; Day Scholars – 750/-.**1. **Group 2:** Professional Courses leading to Degree / Diploma, Certificate in areas like Pharmacy (B.Pharma), LLB, BFS, other para-medical branches like Rehabilitation, Diagnostics etc., Mass Communication, Hotel Management & Catering, Travel/Tourism/Hospitality, Interior Decoration, Nutrition & Dietetics, Commercial Art, Financial Services (e.g. Banking Insurance, Taxation etc.); **Hostellers – 1100/-; Day Scholars – 700/-.**1. **Group 3:** All other courses leading to a Graduate Degree not covered under Group 1 and 2, e.g. BA/B.Sc/B.Com etc. **Hostellers – 950/-; Day Scholars – 650/-.**1. **Group 4:** All Post-Matriculation Level Non-Degree courses for which entrance qualification is High School (Class 10th), e.g. Senior Secondary Certificate (Class 11th and 12th), both general and vocational stream, ITI courses, 3-year diploma courses in Polytechnics etc. **Hostellers – 900/-; Day Scholars – 550/-.** > **Disability Allowances (₹/Annum):** - Visually Impaired – 4000**/-**.- Hearing Impaired – 2000**/-**.- Physically Disabled (OH) – 2000**/-**.- Intellectual Disabilities – 4000**/-**.- All other types of disability not covered above – 2000**/-**. > **Book Allowance:** ₹1500/- per annum.
schemeContent.exclusions_md:
1. Scholarship will not be given to more than two students from a family. Provided in case the second child is a twin, the scholarship will be admissible to both.
1. A scholarship holder under this scheme cannot hold any other scholarship or stipend.
1. If any candidate furnishes false information / document and is established as false. An action will be initiated for recovery of the amount spent with 15% compound interest thereon. Also, such candidate will be blacklisted for future and appropriate legal action can be taken.
1. If a student has to repeat a class, he/she would not get any scholarship for that class for a second (or subsequent) year.

state.label: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The “Unique Disability ID (UDID)” has been launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Government of India, aiming to create a national database of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) and issue a Unique Disability Identity Card to each individual to ensure transparency, efficiency, and ease in delivering government benefits. Through this scheme, Disability Certificates and Unique Disability Identity Cards are provided to Persons with Disabilities across the country. The scheme is implemented by competent medical authorities notified by the respective State Governments and Union Territories through the centralised UDID portal. The project supports online application submission, assessment of disability percentage by hospitals or Medical Boards, online renewal and updating of information, and integrated management of government schemes and benefits for PwDs. It also eliminates duplicate records and enables tracking of the physical and financial progress of beneficiaries at the village, block, district, state, and national levels. District Welfare Officers assist in registration camps and application management, while District Collectors monitor implementation through reporting features available on the portal. **Objectives:** - To create a national database of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs). - To issue a Unique Disability Identity Card (UDID) to each individual. - To ensure transparency, efficiency, and ease in delivering government benefits to PwDs. - To maintain uniformity across regions in disability certification and identification. - To eliminate duplicate records of Persons with Disabilities. - To enable online renewal and updating of disability-related information. - To support integrated management of government benefits and schemes for PwDs. - To provide nationwide availability of PwD data through a centralized web application.
schemeContent.benefits_md: The Unique Disability Identity (UDID) card, also known as the Swavlamban Card, is a mandatory document for persons with disabilities (PwDs) in the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu to access various central and state government welfare schemes. The UDID card ensures a uniform, digitized record that eliminates the need for carrying multiple documents and provides a single, nation-wide proof of disability.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme "RKVY Soil Health and Fertility - Soil Health Card" implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, aims to promote soil test-based nutrient management through providing Soil Health Cards to farmers across India. The Soil Health Card contains the status of soil with respect to 12 parameters, including macro-nutrients, micro-nutrients, and soil properties. Based on the test results, the card provides recommendations regarding fertilizers and soil amendments required for the farm. The scheme also seeks to strengthen soil testing laboratories and build the capacity of district and state-level staff. It helps farmers make informed decisions regarding nutrient management and fertilizer use.

basicDetails.schemeName: National Savings (Monthly Income  Account) Scheme

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The National Savings (Monthly Income Account) Scheme, 2019, popularly known as the Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS), is a government-backed small savings scheme administered by the Ministry of Finance. The scheme provides a fixed monthly income to investors through periodic interest payments on a one-time deposit made at the time of account opening. The scheme is designed for individuals seeking a secure investment option with regular monthly returns. Accounts can be opened individually, jointly by up to three adults, or on behalf of eligible minors. > **Key Features** - Government-backed savings scheme with assured returns. - Single deposit account with no recurring contributions. - Monthly interest payout to the account holder. - Account tenure of 5 years. - Joint accounts permitted with up to three adults. - Nomination facility available as per applicable rules. - Transfer of an account from one post office to another is permitted. - Multiple accounts may be opened subject to the prescribed deposit limits.
schemeContent.benefits_md: > **Deposit Limits** - Minimum Deposit: ₹1,000 and thereafter in multiples of ₹1,000. - Maximum Deposit in Single Account: ₹4,50,000. - Maximum Deposit in Minor Account/Account opened by Guardian: ₹4,50,000. - Maximum Deposit in Joint Account: ₹9,00,000. > **Interest** - Interest Rate: 7.6% per annum (as specified in the 2019 notification; subject to revision by the Government from time to time). - Interest is payable monthly from the date of deposit. - Unclaimed monthly interest does not earn additional interest. > **Maturity** - The account matures after 5 years from the date of opening. - On maturity, the deposited amount along with eligible interest is payable to the account holder upon submission of the prescribed application. > **Premature Closure** - Premature closure is allowed after completion of one year from the date of account opening: - Closure before completion of 3 years: Deduction of 2% of the principal deposit. - Closure after 3 years but before maturity: Deduction of 1% of the principal deposit. > **Death of Account Holder** - In the event of the account holder's death before maturity, the account may be closed and the deposit refunded along with interest up to the month preceding the month of refund, as per applicable rules.

Minimum Deposit: ₹1,000 and thereafter in multiples of ₹1,000.
Maximum Deposit in Single Account: ₹4,50,000.
Maximum Deposit in Minor Account/Account opened by Guardian: ₹4,50,000.
Maximum Deposit in Joint Account: ₹9,00,000.
Interest
Interest Rate: 7.6% per annum (as specified in the 2019 notification; subject to revision by the Government from time to time).
Interest is payable monthly from the date of deposit.
Unclaimed monthly interest does not earn additional interest.
Maturity
The account matures after 5 years from the date of opening.
On maturity, the deposited amount along with eligible interest is payable to the account holder upon submission of the prescribed application.
Premature Closure
Premature closure is allowed after completion of one year from the date of account opening:
Closure before completion of 3 years: Deduction of 2% of the principal deposit.
Closure after 3 years but before maturity: Deduction of 1% of the principal deposit.
Death of Account Holder

In the event of the account holder's death before maturity, the account may be closed and the deposit refunded along with interest up to the month preceding the month of refund, as per applicable rules.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme "Pre-Matric Scholarships to the Students Belonging to Scheduled Castes & Others with Component 1: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students" has been launched by the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India, and aims to support parents of Scheduled Caste children through financial assistance for education at the pre-matric stage, improve participation in education, minimise dropouts, particularly during transition stages, and enhance opportunities for progression to post-matric education. Through this scheme, consolidated academic allowances are provided to Scheduled Caste students studying in Classes IX and X. The scheme is implemented by the State Governments and Union Territory Administrations, which award scholarships to eligible domiciled students. Scholarships are available for studies in India in Government schools and recognised private schools having a valid UDISE code. The scholarship amount is transferred directly to the beneficiary through Direct Benefit Transfer. The scheme also provides additional support to Divyang students through an extra allowance. > **Objective:** - To support, through financial assistance, parents of children belonging to Scheduled Castes for the education of their wards at the pre-matric stage. - To improve the participation of Scheduled Caste students in education. - To minimise the incidence of dropouts, especially during transition from primary to higher levels and from elementary to secondary education. - To improve academic performance and increase opportunities for progression to post-matric education.

Disability should be certified under the provisions of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 by the designated competent authority.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme "Production Linked Incentive Support on JDPs" was launched by the National Jute Board, Ministry of Textiles. The scheme aims to make Indian Jute Diversified Products cost-competitive globally, increase market share, attract more entrepreneurs, and increase export values to ₹16,00,00,00,000/- by 2026. The scheme provides a financial incentive by reimbursing five percent of the cost of jute raw material used in manufacturing exported Jute Diversified Products, limited to three percent of the sales value, subject to a maximum of ₹12,00,000/- per unit per annum. The applicant must be a Jute Mill Company or Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprise unit set up within India engaged in manufacturing and exporting Jute Diversified Products. The scheme is implemented by the National Jute Board. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
schemeContent.benefits_md: - Financial incentive reimbursing 5% of the cost of Jute Raw Material used in manufacturing exported Jute Diversified Products. - The reimbursement is limited to 3% of the sales value of Jute Diversified Products exports, whichever is less. - The maximum financial support provided is ₹12,00,000/- per unit per annum. ##### ***Disbursement*** - Payment for all Jute Material purchased and receipt of export proceeds must be made only through electronic means or banks. No cash transactions will be considered for the incentive. - Claims are paid on a quarterly basis within two months of submission, provided the claims are complete in all respects with the required documentation. - If a claimant misses a quarter, they can submit it with the immediate next quarter's claims along with a written explanation. ##### ***Conditions*** The beneficiaries under the scheme must be Aadhaar-seeded. - The claimants must give an undertaking to the National Jute Board that they have not availed nor will they avail of any other incentive on the Jute Diversified Products production and exports on which this incentive has been claimed. - Claimants must update their documents and data at the beginning of every financial year. - Any unit availing the benefits is liable to return the amount of subsidy with interest (at prevailing bank interest rates for commercial loans) if found to have claimed benefits using false or fraudulent documents.
schemeContent.exclusions_md: - The applicant must not claim incentives for the manufacturing of sacking of any weave and geometry, or yarn for sale. - The applicant must not avail any other parallel incentive on the same Jute Diversified Products production and exports on which this Production Linked Incentive is being claimed.

It provides a financial reimbursement of up to ₹12,00,000/- per annum on raw material costs for Jute Mill Companies and MSME units engaged in exporting JDPs.

Registration
Step 1:
Accessing the Portal

The applicant must visit the official portal of the National Jute Board at www.jute.com to initiate the process. They must navigate to the prescribed online form titled ‘PLI Beneficiaries Registration’.
Step 2:
Submitting Online Registration

The applicant must accurately fill out the registration form with their business details and upload all the necessary compliance documents. Upon successful registration, the applicant will be provided with an online registration password to facilitate future claim submissions.
Application
Step 1:
Accessing the Claim Form
Using the provided online registration password, the applicant must log into the portal at www.jute.com. The applicant must locate and open the prescribed form titled ‘PLI Claim Submission’.
Step 2:
Submitting Quarterly Claims

The applicant must submit their claims online on a quarterly basis by detailing their production and exports of Jute Diversified Products for that period. All mandatory proof documents, such as shipping bills, bank transaction details, and certified chartered accountant reports, must be uploaded before final submission.
Post-Application Process
Step 1:
Verification and Disbursement

The National Jute Board will review the submitted claims and cross-verify the uploaded documents. Once validated, the incentive amount will be paid on a quarterly basis within two months of the submission of a complete claim.
Step 2:
Grievance and Clarification

Any shortcomings found during the examination of the claims will be communicated to the claimants through email. The applicants must submit their compliance or clarifications via email only to ensure speedy disposal.

It provides skill training, machine subsidies, and financial incentives to collaborating agencies, targeting artisans, women self-help groups, and entrepreneurs.
schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme "Jute Diversification Scheme" was launched by the National Jute Board, Ministry of Textiles, Government of India. The scheme aims to spread jute diversification programs, provide training, and create sustained employment by setting up Jute Resource-cum-Production Centres across the country. The scheme provides basic, advanced, and design training in jute diversified products manufacturing, financial incentives for collaborating agencies, and subsidies for procuring machinery. schemeContent.detailedDescription_md:
PM POSHAN is a centrally sponsored scheme by the Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education. Under this scheme, one hot cooked meal will be provided to the children studying in Government and Government – aided schools. The Scheme is implemented across the country covering all the eligible children without any discrimination of gender and social class. > **Objective:** The main objectives of the PM POSHAN Abhiyaan are to address two of the pressing problems for the majority of children in India, viz. hunger and education by improving the nutritional status of eligible children in Government and Government-aided schools as well as encouraging poor children, belonging to disadvantaged sections, to attend school more regularly and help them concentrate on classroom activities.
POSHAN Abhiyaan is one of the many schemes under the umbrella scheme "Integrated Child Development Services Scheme (ICDS)". ICDS also includes Anganwadi Services Scheme, Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana, and Scheme for Adolescent Girls.
